'''Kimaru''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
At some point, Kimaru was imprisoned inside the [[Chamber of Banishment]] on Dathomir, where her life essence was trapped inside a large [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] entered the chamber, causing Kimaru to be freed from her crystal. She then proceeded to attack them, but was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kimaru was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kimaru was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
